text: [excited] Can I 3D print whatever bumper I want?
[matter-of-fact] Sure. Scan the car. Design it.
[dry] Six or seven kilos of filament. The good stuff's about two hundred bucks.
[sighs] ...No. [matter-of-fact] That's easily two hundred fifty hours of work.
[dry] And it's still heavier. And weaker.
[matter-of-fact] If you can buy it? Yep. Printing a rep doesn't make financial sense... [thoughtful] unless it's discontinued, or you're making them to sell.
[pleading] But I want a custom one!
[resigned, slight smile] ...If you insist. We'll show you how.
